**Description**

* Experience & Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) with 4-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience building production web applications or distributed microservices.
* Core Backend & Full-Stack Development: 3+ years of hands-on experience writing, debugging, and optimizing production code in Modern Java (JDK 17+), Spring Boot, and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Cloud & Container Fundamentals: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying cloud-native applications on GCP (or AWS/Azure) utilizing Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and Docker.
* Automated Testing & CI/CD Ownership: Demonstrated experience owning code quality end-to-end using automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Mockito, WireMock, RestAssured) and working with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Helm Charts, and Terraform.
* Context Engineering & LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating LLMs into software workflows specifically building or consuming RAG pipelines, structuring prompts/context windows, and validating AI outputs for accuracy and safety.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* GCP Data & Messaging Ecosystem: Hands-on experience working with Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Bigtable, GCS, or Cloud Composer (Airflow).
* Frontend Web Development: Experience developing responsive UI components using Angular
* Database & Modern Build Tooling: Proficiency with relational/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cloud SQL) and modern build/version control tools (Maven, Gradle, Git).
* Regulated Domain Experience: Prior experience building secure, compliant software within FinTech, banking, credit, or data-intensive enterprise environments.

description:
**Software Engineer - JAVA(Pune)**
Dassault Systemes' ENOVIA is the world's leading solution for collaborative product development and lifecycle management. Deployed by global leaders such as Honda, Toyota, Boeing, and Airbus — across 12 industries spanning mobility, aerospace, life sciences, and infrastructure — it manages the complete journey of a product from concept to end-of-life.
  
  
The ENOVIA India R&D team, designs and builds the next generation of PLM solutions on cloud. Our products directly influence how the world's manufacturers design, validate, change, and realize complex products. We work in an AI-augmented engineering model: leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery; human engineers provide the domain judgment, architectural oversight, and quality validation that AI cannot replace.
  
  
As a Java Developer in ENOVIA R&D India, you will design, develop, and maintain server-side Java components that power the ENOVIA applications — that are central to how the world's leading organizations manage their product lifecycle. You will work on backend services and data modeling, where reliability, scalability, and data integrity are foundational requirements.
  
  
You will leverage AI coding assistants to accelerate development of Java services while applying disciplined review to validate generated output for correctness, security, and compliance with design standards. You should understand where AI assistance is genuinely useful in core Java development, and where human precision is irreplaceable.
  
  
**Role Description & Responsibilities**

* Define, develop, and maintain software modules and features with a focus on reliability, scalability, and data integrity.
* As part of an AI-enabled SDLC, leverage AI coding assistants for development, code reviews, and test case generation, while ensuring the quality and safety of AI-generated output.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to translate product requirements into implementations
* Resolve technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation — creating new and innovative ways to improve platform applications.
* Work closely with customers on real-time production issues, providing timely diagnosis and resolution.
* Collaborate effectively with a geographically distributed team.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers; contribute to hiring and team-building efforts.

PLM / Domain Skills
  
  

* Development exposure to ENOVIA or equivalent PLM platforms
* Awareness of PLM domain concepts: BOM, Engineering Change Management, Product Configuration, Document Management
* Industry exposure: automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, life sciences, infrastructure (nice to have)

**AI Skills**

* Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) in real workflow
* Critical review of AI-generated code: logic errors, security risks, edge cases, style
* Effective prompt writing and iterative refinement of AI output
* AI for non-code tasks: requirement drafting, test case generation, documentation

**Software Engineering Skills**

* CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OOD, design patterns — applied to applications in production
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis across distributed codebases
* Good knowledge of DevOps and Cloud technologies; ability to write basic SQL queries.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot applications and environment issues.

**JAVA Skills**

* Strong core Java proficiency — Java 11 or later; solid understanding of the Java memory model, garbage collection, and JVM behavior.
* Experience with Java/J2EE, JMS, Message Broker, and Java stack technologies in a professional product or enterprise context.
* Strong system thinking skills to design and build scalable, reliable, and maintainable Java-based backend systems
* Good knowledge of Client-Server architectures and RESTful API design.

**Collaboration & Soft Skills**

* Good team spirit and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written, Verbal, Communication skills, Analytical skills & Business thinking.
* Adaptability, ability to learn faster, to be independent, responsible and diligent

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Sciences, or a related discipline from a reputed institution with a good academic track record.
* 5 to 7 years of hands-on professional experience with design and development of complex Java software products, with exposure to unit testing tools.

**What's In It For You**

* Work at the intersection of deep PLM domain expertise and AI-augmented engineering; a rare combination that will define the highest-value development of the decade.
* Contribute to products used by global industry leaders across 12 sectors, directly influencing how major manufacturers design and build the products we all use.
* Grow in an environment that values engineering craft, domain curiosity, and AI fluency equally; not just raw coding.
* Collaborate with engineering colleagues across the globe as part of a world-class PLM organization.
* Be part of a team actively shaping how AI is integrated into enterprise product engineering - from the inside.

Inclusion statement
  
  
As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

****Full-Stack Developer****

* Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.
* Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards.

* Strong debugging skills, end-to-end ownership, clean-code discipline, and peer-review practices.
* Ability to lead client-facing technical discussions, decompose requirements, estimate work efforts, and communicate architecture trade-offs.
* Experience with .NET, .NET Core, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights.

* Exposure to Azure OpenAI integration, Next.js, Python, Copilot extensibility, Docker, or Dataverse integration.
* Secure, tested, and responsive applications and APIs.
* Reliable identity and enterprise-system integrations.
* Maintainable custom-code foundations for AI agents, Microsoft 365 (M365), and Power Platform solutions.
* Clear monitoring, documentation, and operational handoff.

* Write automated tests and contribute to agent evaluations that assess workflow behavior and response accuracy
* Investigate issues using logs, metrics, and traces; help improve performance, reliability, and customer experience
* Follow security and data-handling standards, including tenant isolation and appropriate handling of personal information
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with Product, SDET, platform, and domain teams to deliver maintainable solutions

* Professional software engineering experience, with examples of delivering software that had customer or business impact
* Experience developing and supporting production applications or services
* Proficiency in Python or another backend programming language, and willingness to work with Python-based services
* Ability to write efficient system prompts to get LLMs to work for the required tasks
* Working knowledge of React and Node.js
* Good to have projects involving LLM applications, including frontier models, prompt design, tool calling, structured outputs, conversation state, and core LLM concepts such as tokens
* Experience with AWS, containers, Redis, caching, or event-driven systems
* Knowledge of API design, SQL, relational databases, and automated testing
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, openness to feedback, and ability to collaborate across teams
* Experience monitoring and troubleshooting production systems using tools such as New Relic, including reviewing logs, metrics, traces, and alerts
* Experience using AI coding tools such as Codex or Cursor
* Ability to use AI tools such as Codex to plan and execute Epic development effectively

* Experience with or knowledge of LLM APIs, tool calling, prompt design, or conversational applications
* Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or similar platforms for agent runtime, authentication, and orchestration
* Familiarity with MCP, FastMCP, Pydantic, or similar frameworks
* Exposure to observability or agent evaluation tools such as Langfuse
* Knowledge of property management services and leasing workflows
* A portfolio of LLM projects on GitHub

title: BI & Analytics Lead
description:
Advertising is being rebuilt around AI, and creators and partners are becoming one of its most powerful channels. Yet most advertisers still run them across scattered tools and manual processes, from partner discovery to payouts. One of our clients DeltaX, brings discovery, partner management, tracking and payments into the same universal buying stack as the rest of the media plan, so influencer and affiliate can be planned, measured and scaled like any other channel. Few platforms can do this today.

Imagine finding, contracting, tracking and paying thousands of creators and partners as easily as launching a search campaign. This is what you will be working on.

As Solutions Lead for Influencer & Affiliate, you are the expert on how these programmes should run on our platform. You understand the ecosystem: how partners are found and recruited, the deal types and engagement models, how performance is tracked and how partners get paid. You help advertisers and agencies design programmes that fit their goals and guide teams on setting them up well.

You also build the practice behind it: the standards, playbooks and know-how that let us do this brilliantly at scale. When a question gets complex, you are the expert Client Success turns to.

Experience: 5 to 7+ years | CTC: 12LPA - 20LPA

**What Success looks like**

**North Star: Every advertiser trusts their numbers and acts on what they see**

**In your first 3 months**

* You know our analytics and reporting solution inside out, can demo and solution it independently, and advertisers and agencies leave excited about what it can do
* You have led onboarding for new advertisers and agencies and turned their requirements into live, trusted dashboards
* You have set clear standards for dashboard design, metric definitions and data joins

**In your first 6 months**

* The practice runs on clear, documented processes, templates and playbooks, not one-off builds
* You own the reporting process end to end and drive it with the Client Success and operations teams
* Your client insight is shaping what we build next, with at least one new capability on the roadmap because of you

**Solutioning and design**

* Take incoming reporting requests and translate them into clear requirements: metrics, dimensions, filters and views
* Create a design overview for each dashboard, shaped by the advertiser's industry and vertical, that the operations team can build from
* Define the data joins and metric logic needed across sources, and validate them using SQL
* Shape how AI-assisted insights, natural-language querying and automated analysis sit on top of advertiser dashboards
* Analyse advertiser performance data to find what is driving results, and present clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders
* Define the KPI frameworks and metric definitions advertisers and agencies run their business on
* Bring attribution and MMM outputs into reporting so advertisers and agencies can act on them
* Own data quality and trust in the numbers across sources

**Advertiser and agency engagement**

* Run product demos and training sessions for advertisers, agencies and internal teams
* Own client success during onboarding, then act as the expert Client Success can call on
* Partner with Client Success on nuanced reporting questions after onboarding

**Process and enablement**

* Own and manage the reporting process, from request intake to delivery
* Direct the operations team that builds dashboards, reviewing output against the design intent
* Create and maintain documentation: design standards, metric definitions, playbooks and training material
* Spot patterns across advertisers and agencies, and turn them into new solutions and product ideas
* Work with product and engineering when a client need calls for something new

**What Will You Bring**

* 5 to 7+ years in BI, data analytics, reporting or dashboarding, ideally within an agency, adtech, martech or a data-led business
* Strong SQL, comfortable designing joins across multiple data sources
* Comfort using AI for analysis and insight generation, with good judgement on where it can and cannot be trusted
* A track record of designing dashboards from scratch and explaining the reasoning behind them
* Strong analytical skills: you find the story in the data and communicate it clearly to senior, non-technical audiences
* Strong design thinking: turns a vague request into a clear dashboard blueprint others can build from, tailored to the advertiser's industry
* Confidence leading client calls, demos and platform trainings
* Strong process and documentation skills: you write things down so others can run them
* An AI-first mindset: you use AI every day and want to shape how it changes advertising

**Good To Have**

* Experience with marketing data, such as joining ad platform data with CRM or sales data
* Hands-on use of a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau
* Understanding of campaign KPIs and attribution
* Experience building a reporting practice or standards from the ground up

**What You Get**

* Own the analytics and reporting solution. You shape how advertisers turn unified data into insight on our platform, and how the product evolves to do it better.
* Work at the cutting edge of AI-driven analytics, from natural-language querying to automated insight, on unified cross-channel data.
* A voice in what we build. You work closely with product and engineering, and your client insight shapes the roadmap.
* Room to grow. Your scope, influence and team grow as the practice scales.

**About DeltaX**

Founded in 2012, DeltaX is building the future of how media is bought. Advertising is being rebuilt around AI, and we are building the stack it runs on: a universal buying platform that helps advertisers and their agencies plan, create, buy, measure and report across every major platform and channel, with agentic AI and orchestration at the core.

Netrix Global is looking for a skilled
**Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics**

Working directly with customers and alongside Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, and service desk leadership, the Business Analyst ensures that the performance story Netrix tells its customers is timely, consistent, and backed by trusted data.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
*****Customer Service Desk Reporting*****

* Produce, automate, and deliver monthly customer service reports and Netrix template service review presentations, enabling Service Delivery Managers to share them with customers during the first week of each month.
* Report SLA attainment by priority for response and resolution, including tickets opened and closed, backlog, mean time to resolve, reopened rates, escalations, and major incident activity.

* Report contact center performance metrics, including average speed of answer, average handle time, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, and channel mix across phone, email, portal, and chat.

*****Internal Operational and Financial Reporting*****

* Maintain daily operational reporting, including open and aging ticket reports, daily and month-to-date SLA status, and queue health.

At Aligned Automation, we live by our "Better Together" philosophy to build a better world. We are seeking a Business Analyst who can find out how a department really works and turn that into clear, evidence-based documents. You will run discovery interviews, map processes, collect and analyse operational data, and write the requirements, process maps and matrices that our engagements deliver. You will work under a Senior Consultant or Program Lead on process excellence and digital transformation engagements, often for government and public-services organizations with many departments and external stakeholders. Experience with government, infrastructure or utilities clients is strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and run discovery interviews, document reviews and process walkthroughs with department heads, section leads and front-line staff; record outcomes in structured meeting summaries.
* Build and maintain a process repository: process names, owners, triggers, inputs and outputs, systems, approvals and tiering.
* Map current-state (As-Is) processes as swimlane maps, one lane per department or role, using BPMN or an equivalent standard.
* Design future-state (To-Be) processes with the Senior Consultant, applying eliminate, simplify and standardise changes only where they add value.
* Log observations and gaps across process, people, technology and governance in a gap register, with evidence, impact rating and quick wins.
* Draft SLA and Delegation of Authority (DoA) matrices for decision, approval and financial steps, with approval chains shown as role hierarchies.
* Draft RACI matrices, including hand-offs between the client and external authorities (municipalities, utilities, regulators).
* Issue data requests in the first week and analyse volumes, turnaround times, rejection reasons and service-time data; build time-and-motion samples where data is missing.
* Prepare volume and effort inputs for workload-based staffing models (activity drivers × standard time × complexity) and check them with process owners.
* Document business and system requirements (BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) for ERP and workflow enhancements, such as SAP changes, and keep a traceability log.
* Track reviews, versions and sign-offs for each deliverable, and keep the RAID log and weekly status inputs up to date.
* Prepare clear workshop and steering-committee material: process maps, summary decks and one-page findings.
* Contribute templates and lessons learned to the practice's reusable accelerators.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Management or a related field.
* 5 years of experience in business analysis, process consulting or transformation projects, with at least 2 years in client-facing roles.
* Hands-on experience in As-Is and To-Be process mapping and gap analysis on at least two engagements.
* Experience writing BRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and supporting UAT.
* Experience running or co-running stakeholder interviews and workshops, and turning them into structured documentation.
* Strong data skills: advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, formula-driven models); comfortable cleaning and analysing operational data.
* Working knowledge of a process modelling tool (Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, ARIS or similar) and strong PowerPoint skills.
* Clear, concise business English, written and spoken.
* Attention to detail: version control, consistent naming, and evidence for every finding.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with government or public-sector clients, in infrastructure, utilities, roads, permits, or municipal services.
* Exposure to SAP or another ERP (e.g. SAP S/4HANA modules such as PM, MM or FI)
* Experience building SLA, DoA or RACI matrices, or workload-based staffing inputs.
* Certifications such as ECBA / CCBA, PMI-PBA, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or Agile (CSPO, CSM).
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps or Confluence; basic Power BI or SQL.
